summary: SIEM feed s070_single is overloaded: microbursts peak at 3.73 Gbps vs 1 Gbps port (373% capacity, 3 intervals) causing ingress drops. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker forwards unsliced, unfiltered aggregate at full packet size with no load-balancing or rate-shaping. 1ms bursts hit 3.73 Gbps, exceeding the SIEM's 1 Gbps port capacity, causing buffer overrun and tail drops at the tool ingress.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM randomly drops packets during bursts, missing flow/event records and creating gaps in correlation, alerting and forensic coverage. Sustained 373% overload guarantees incomplete visibility.

recommended_fix.why: SIEM profile needs_full_payload=false and max_encrypted_share=1.0, so it only needs headers/metadata for correlation. Slicing to ~512B retains L2-L7 headers while cutting burst throughput well below 1 Gbps without new hardware. If full payload retention is required, use load_balance across 4x1G ports with 5-tuple hash instead.
